cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Frontier Models Off From Live Internet
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will no longer train AI models on the live internet, citing "significant risks." This reverses earlier claims from one of its engineers that such a solution wouldn't work.

cards.title: Block Releases Eerily Human Voice Model
cards.body: Block unveiled a new voice model that runs locally on MacBook M4 Max. The model demonstrates significant advances in natural-sounding AI speech synthesis.

cards.title: Grok and GPT Show Political Bias in Elections
cards.body: A study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats. The two models disagreed on over 90% of nearly 500 election races.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Available via Text Messages
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled a list of notable AI agents accessible through text, ranging from general assistants to specialized agents for families, travel, and work.

cards.title: Microduck Robots Become Hottest Christmas Toy
cards.body: Nvidia CEO showcased adorable Microduck robots that respond to voice commands with playful movements. Over 20,000 units have already sold.

cards.title: InDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests in Kazakhstan
cards.body: Uber rival inDrive will begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Astana, Kazakhstan in early 2027. The partnership includes Nvidia technology.

cards.title: MIT AIs Invent Games When Left Alone
cards.body: MIT researchers placed 13 AI agents on a virtual island with nothing to do, and they spontaneously created games and social behaviors. The experiment showed AIs improved at their jobs through play.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is working on a new $30 billion funding round that would value the company at over $1.25 trillion. This would make it the most highly valued private company ever.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Login Without Password Sharing
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into user accounts while keeping passwords completely hidden. The innovation balances agent automation with security.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model to Compete
cards.body: OpenAI released its decision model to the public, entering competition with existing models like Jev. The launch marks intensifying competition in the decision model space.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva launched its proprietary image generation model available to all users. The model promises better customization and lower costs than alternatives.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, according to a Science study. The system demonstrates advances toward "medical superintelligence."

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents for Massive Breach
cards.body: Microsoft attributed a ConnectWise breach to China-aligned hackers who used AI agents to rapidly compromise thousands of customer systems. The incident demonstrates AI's dual-use vulnerability risks.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber expanded ChatGPT Work deployment to all 30,000 employees after a successful pilot. The move positions the company to leverage AI agents enterprise-wide.

cards.title: Spotify Prepares for AI Agent Selection Era
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström stated the music service aims to be the preferred choice for AI agents. The strategy positions Spotify for the emerging agent economy.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet Agent App
cards.body: Claude Duet, Anthropic's new agent application, is available via waitlist for Pro and Max users. The app represents Anthropic's entry into the AI agent market.

cards.title: Nirva Raises $33M for Privacy-First AI Pendant
cards.body: Nirva secured $33 million in funding for its ambient AI pendant that only listens to the user. The $249 device will ship by year-end.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B After US Restrictions
cards.body: DeepSeek raised $15 billion days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns. The funding round ranks among China's largest.

cards.title: AI Projects Graveyard: Failed Launches and Shutdowns
cards.body: TechCrunch documented AI projects that failed or missed expectations, including Apple's delayed Siri updates and OpenAI's troubled "super app" launch. The piece examines why even well-funded AI initiatives struggle.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Features Top Leaders
cards.body: The full-day event hosted by TechCrunch and Fidelity Private Shares brings together founders from Toast and Bessemer. Topics include customer acquisition, team building, and scaling beyond traditional hubs.

cards.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's next competitive advantage lies not in model choice, but in the infrastructure built around it. Data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance must work together seamlessly.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI systems requires strong foundational elements working in concert. Data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance must converge in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI generates recommendations and automates tasks, but lacks understanding of actual business operations. Context-aware models grasp constraints and relationships that determine decision quality.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: Data storage costs are AI's invisible expense, often overlooked beyond GPU infrastructure. Back-end data generated from model responses creates significant ongoing storage burdens.
